evals.prompt:
I need to migrate astrazeneca.com to EDS. Let's start with an audit. Here are the representative pages I picked:
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/ (homepage)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/careers/great-place-to-work.html (content page)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/our-therapy-areas.html (listing/index page)
This is a fresh EDS project with only boilerplate blocks.
evals.expected_output: A complete gap analysis at .specify/migration/gap-analysis.md with patterns deduplicated across the 3 pages, classified into tiers, and a recommended execution order. Also patterns.md and block-inventory.md.
expectations: The migration directory structure is created with pages/ subdirectories for each of the 3 URLs
Each scraped page directory contains at least screenshot.png and cleaned.html
identify-page-structure analysis is performed for each page (sections and content sequences documented)
A block-inventory.md file is created listing ONLY local blocks and Block Collection blocks — no 'Blocks to Create' or 'Blocks to Modify' sections
A patterns.md file is created with deduplicated patterns across all 3 pages
A gap-analysis.md file is created as the primary deliverable
gap-analysis.md contains classification tables for Tier 1 (Covered), Tier 2 (Variant), and Tier 3 (New Block)
Tier 3 and Tier 2 tables include an Effort column with S/M/L ratings
gap-analysis.md includes a Page Readiness Matrix showing which pages are blocked on which blocks
gap-analysis.md includes a Recommended Execution Order section
gap-analysis.md includes Global Style Observations (colors, typography, spacing)
gap-analysis.md includes a Structural Decisions section with key architectural choices
gap-analysis.md includes a Risk Assessment table with likelihood, impact, and mitigation
Patterns in patterns.md have frequency counts and list of pages where each appears
Similar patterns across different pages are grouped as one pattern (deduplication happened)
block-inventory.md does NOT contain any classification, tier, or recommendation content — it is purely descriptive of existing blocks
Every pattern in patterns.md appears in exactly one tier of gap-analysis.md (no orphans, no duplicates)

evals.prompt:
I want to migrate our company site to Edge Delivery Services. Can you audit these pages to figure out what blocks we need?
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/our-therapy-areas.html
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/sustainability.html
Just two pages for now, I'll add more later.
evals.expected_output: The skill handles a minimal 2-page audit gracefully, warns the user that 2 pages may not cover all templates, and still produces complete artifacts.
expectations: The skill warns or notes that 2 pages is fewer than the recommended minimum (5-15 pages)
Both pages are scraped and analyzed (2 page directories exist with scrape outputs)
gap-analysis.md is produced with all required sections (summary, tiers, execution order, page readiness, structural decisions, risk assessment)
patterns.md lists patterns with frequency counts that correctly reflect the 2-page set
The output acknowledges that coverage may be incomplete and suggests adding more pages
block-inventory.md contains ONLY existing blocks — no prescriptive sections about what to build
Tier tables include Effort column with S/M/L ratings

evals.prompt:
We're migrating from our old CMS to AEM Edge Delivery. I've identified these pages as representative of all our templates:
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/ (homepage)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/careers/great-place-to-work.html (careers content)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/our-therapy-areas.html (therapy areas landing)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/sustainability.html (sustainability landing)
- https://www.astrazeneca.com/investor-relations.html (investor relations)
After the audit I want to feed the results into speckit for block development. Make sure the output is ready for that.
evals.expected_output: A thorough 5-page audit with speckit integration clearly marked — Tier 3 blocks tagged for full speckit pipeline, Tier 2 for abbreviated, Tier 1 for no speckit.
expectations: All 5 pages are scraped into separate page directories with scrape outputs
If parallel scraping fails, sequential fallback is attempted (skill mentions this option)
Pattern deduplication produces fewer unique patterns than total content sequences across all pages
Tier 3 (New Block) entries reference the full speckit pipeline: specify → plan → tasks → implement → validate
Tier 2 (Variant) entries reference the abbreviated speckit flow: specify → plan → implement → validate
Tier 1 (Covered) entries explicitly state no speckit workflow is needed
gap-analysis.md summary table shows counts for all three tiers
Tier 3 and Tier 2 tables include Effort column with S/M/L ratings
Recommended Execution Order prioritizes patterns by frequency (high-frequency first)
Page Readiness Matrix shows which specific blocks are blocking each page
Structural Decisions section identifies key architectural choices (e.g., extend header vs new mega-nav)
Risk Assessment table lists migration risks with likelihood, impact, and mitigation
block-inventory.md is purely descriptive of existing blocks — no 'Blocks to Create' sections
block-inventory.md exists listing both local and Block Collection blocks
